simple.meaning: מַפְתֵּחַ (maphtêach) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an opener , i.e. a key.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Judges 3:25. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַפְתֵּחַ (H4668) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מַפְתֵּחַ (maphtêach) / H4668 is traced through Judges 3:25, Isaiah 22:22 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

timeline.evidenceText: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.
